description: Enhanced Partial Expansion A* (EPEA*) is A* that generates only the children it needs now. Each node stores a value `F`, at first its own `f = g + h`. When EPEA* expands a node, it generates only the children whose `f` equals `F`, then raises `F` to the next larger child value and puts the node back, or closes it if there is none. An *operator selection function* finds these children directly, without generating the others. In `mapf-search`, `epea` runs it in the joint space of all agents, where a node has a huge number of children: the plan is optimal, and an unsolvable instance is proved unsolvable.

papers.authors: Meir Goldenberg, Ariel Felner, Roni Stern, Guni Sharon, Nathan Sturtevant, Robert C. Holte, Jonathan Schaeffer
papers.title: Enhanced Partial Expansion A*
